title: Non-Aza'raan Naming Atlas
warnings: Older text has been screened for several known direct contradictions but has not been promoted into active AWS canon.
Stored as text. HTML prototypes are not executed and cannot replace AWS code.

sections.title: Kaluseban
sections.text:
name: Kaluseban

influences: ["Korean","French"]

status: strict_original_species

source_name: Kalusebans

syllable_pattern: (C)V.CV.CV; usually 3-5 syllables

phonetic_design: Korean-inspired consonant economy and rhythmic syllables meet French-style flowing vowels and r/l transitions. Allow occasional nasal final in historical names.

naming_template: Fuse a Korean-inspired meaningful root and French-inspired root. Transform both for the fictional Kaluseban phonology; avoid simply attaching two unchanged real words.

constructed_semantic_roots: gyer = constancy; fer = resolution; mer = devoted care; thal = enduring bond (all fictional Kaluseban root interpretations).

custom_notes: User supplied the ten sample fusions. "Han-gyeol" means steady or consistent in the user example and French ferme means firm. The new blends are Kaluseban proposals, not Korean or French words.

examples: [{"name":"Yermifana","reading":"Yehr-mee-FAH-nah","proposed_meaning":"A steadfast spirit whose resolve never breaks"},{"name":"Meryefina","reading":"Mehr-yeh-FEE-nah","proposed_meaning":"Unwavering devotion of heart and purpose"},{"name":"Salmyeoro","reading":"Sahl-myeh-OH-roh","proposed_meaning":"Firmly grounded, enduring through every change"},{"name":"Gyerfima","reading":"Gyehr-FEE-mah","proposed_meaning":"Consistent strength, courage and reliability"},{"name":"Constefaria","reading":"Kohn-steh-FAH-ree-ah","proposed_meaning":"Everlasting loyalty and unchanging conviction"},{"name":"Stanyefeo","reading":"Stahn-yeh-FEH-oh","proposed_meaning":"One who remains steadfast against all adversity"},{"name":"Thalferye","reading":"Thahl-FEHR-yeh","proposed_meaning":"Enduring strength, stability and inner peace"},{"name":"Thagyermi","reading":"Thah-GYEHR-mee","proposed_meaning":"An unshakable will and resolute spirit"},{"name":"Marangiye","reading":"Mah-rahn-GYEH","proposed_meaning":"Resilient, dependable and unwavering"},{"name":"Yufergyel","reading":"Yoo-fehr-GYEHL","proposed_meaning":"One whose existence and convictions cannot be shaken"}]

variants: ["Psionic","Swamp","Arcane","Dark","Stone","Oceanic"]

name_status: proposed for author approval

sections.title: Tamhiogal
sections.text:
name: Tamhiogal

influences: ["Arabic","Polish"]

status: strict_original_species

source_name: Tamhiogals

syllable_pattern: CV.CCV.CV or CV.CV.CCV; 2-4 syllables

phonetic_design: Arabic-inspired emphatic or pharyngeal-feeling transitions are adapted for fiction; Polish-inspired sibilants, soft consonants and clusters are smoothed for Tamhiogal speech. Never require difficult clusters for every speaker.

naming_template: Meaning root + water or family root; the second root may modify the first. Endings -a, -in and -eya are optional regional inventions.

constructed_semantic_roots: nur = light or beacon; fala = returning wave; mir = sheltered reef; zaw = pledge (fictional Tamhiogal root meanings, not claims about Earth translation).

custom_notes: Arabic nūr and Polish fala are real lexical examples meaning light and wave. The blends are inventions, not phrases in either language.

examples: [{"name":"Nurfaleya","reading":"noor-fah-LEH-yah","proposed_meaning":"A light returning with the tide"},{"name":"Mirszanira","reading":"meer-shah-NEE-rah","proposed_meaning":"Shelter offered to the lost"},{"name":"Zawadira","reading":"zah-wah-DEE-rah","proposed_meaning":"One who keeps a promise across the sea"},{"name":"Falnurina","reading":"fahl-noo-REE-nah","proposed_meaning":"Beacon over the living water"},{"name":"Mazrelya","reading":"mahz-REHL-yah","proposed_meaning":"A safe channel through storms"},{"name":"Sahwirena","reading":"sah-wee-REH-nah","proposed_meaning":"Patient keeper of the shore"}]

sections.title: Dril'thar
sections.text:
name: Dril'thar

influences: ["Ancient or Old Egyptian","Navajo (Diné Bizaad)","Taa (!Xóõ / !Xoon)"]

status: strict_original_species

source_name: Dril’thars

syllable_pattern: Optional CLICK + CV.CV or CV.CV.CV; do not require a click in every name

phonetic_design: Egyptian transliteration inspires consonant-rich pictorial ancestry, Navajo inspires controlled vowel length, nasality, tone and selected glottalic contrasts; Taa supplies the click articulation model. No literal Navajo or Taa words are copied.

naming_template: Honor name = optional click onset + one or two fictional roots + community ending. A click may also appear medially; ceremonial and everyday names can differ.

constructed_semantic_roots: khe = river memory; sena = refuge; maru = glimmer; naki = ancestral path; tsu = listening (all constructed Dril’thar roots).

custom_notes: All Dril’thar naming traditions belong to Dril’thar communities. Taa click symbols indicate distinct sounds, not decoration. No direct Egyptian-era vowel pronunciation is claimed.

examples: [{"name":"ǃKhemaru","reading":"[alveolar click] kheh-MAH-roo","proposed_meaning":"One who guards river memory"},{"name":"ǀSenaki","reading":"[dental click] seh-NAH-kee","proposed_meaning":"Listener along the sheltered path"},{"name":"ǁNamaru","reading":"[lateral click] nah-MAH-roo","proposed_meaning":"The water remembers their light"},{"name":"ǂTsenahe","reading":"[palatal click] tseh-NAH-heh","proposed_meaning":"A guide through mist"},{"name":"ʘMekanu","reading":"[bilabial click] meh-KAH-noo","proposed_meaning":"Guardian of the living spring"},{"name":"Nakiǃra","reading":"nah-kee [alveolar click] rah","proposed_meaning":"One whose voice returns with the tide"},{"name":"Khenáru","reading":"kheh-NAH-roo","proposed_meaning":"Glow in the marsh at night"},{"name":"ǀTsumare","reading":"[dental click] tsoo-MAH-reh","proposed_meaning":"Protector of healing waters"},{"name":"ǁHénaki","reading":"[lateral click] HEH-nah-kee","proposed_meaning":"Remembrance shared with family"},{"name":"ǃTsenamaru","reading":"[alveolar click] tseh-nah-MAH-roo","proposed_meaning":"Bright memory carried in the current"}]

variants: ["Grassland","Lush Forest","Marsh","Rainforest","Ocean","Reef"]

name_status: proposed for author approval
